purpose: Reconcile two or more plausible conservative-care patterns into one coherent Keneflex plan before product selection.
principles: Do not add condition-specific treatment lists together mechanically.
Preserve unique treatment requirements for each surviving pattern.
Check whether any intervention, product, timing instruction, or restriction for one pattern conflicts with another.
Use one product only when it genuinely satisfies every required role; otherwise use separate products or separate time-of-use strategies.
Avoid redundant products when one item adequately covers multiple roles.
If evidence is incomplete or the combination materially raises uncertainty, lower recommendation confidence or escalate rather than pretending certainty.
Product-level eligibility and safety checks occur after treatment reconciliation, not before it.
resolver_cycle: retrieve first-line conservative-care recommendations for each pattern
identify conflicts or incompatible use instructions
send treatment requirements to product intelligence
cross-check selected products against all active patterns and warnings
define follow-up and failure criteria for each pattern

shared: reduce or modify provoking repetitive load
median_nerve_unique: maintain a neutral wrist during sleep when clinically appropriate
avoid prolonged wrist positions that reproduce nerve-type symptoms
radial_thumb_tendon_unique: reduce painful repetitive thumb motion and combined thumb/wrist loading
median_nerve_pattern_plus_radial_thumb_t.reconciliation_rule: Do not assume a daytime wrist/thumb support is also the correct night neutral-wrist support. Product intelligence must verify that one product satisfies both roles; otherwise recommend separate day/activity and night strategies.
median_nerve_pattern_plus_radial_thumb_t.follow_up: Track nerve-type symptoms and thumb-side pain separately because one may improve while the other persists.

shared: adaptive setup or tools where relevant
median_nerve_unique: neutral wrist strategy, especially during sleep when appropriate
thumb_base_joint_unique: thumb-base support or adaptive grip strategy when appropriate
median_nerve_pattern_plus_thumb_base_joi.reconciliation_rule: Preserve neutral-wrist requirements without unnecessarily immobilizing the thumb all day; add thumb-specific support only where the thumb pattern requires it.
median_nerve_pattern_plus_thumb_base_joi.follow_up: Track nocturnal/nerve symptoms separately from pinch/grip thumb-base pain.

inputs: consumer preferences and budget after adequacy
product_engine_contract.output_rule: A product is eligible only if it satisfies every treatment-role requirement assigned to it and does not conflict with the other components of the combined plan.
